# Planeir

> See the different routes to your financial goals. Use your goals and figures to explore different choices, compare the trade-offs and get a clearer picture of the way forward. Currently available for demos only.

- Request demo access through the form. Information is saved so the person can return, update it while waiting, and review it when approved.
- Reusable demo invitations grant access directly. Each participant has independent saved information and a private return link.
- Generate my analysis saves the approved person's confirmed information. Analysis generation is not connected yet; no AI or calculations run in this flow.
- Saved information remains until the person deletes it from their private form. Clear this device removes the local draft and browser session only.
- Financial education, not regulated advice or product recommendations. Optional calls are secondary and appear only beside completed results in the separate analysis service.
- With the person's agreement, an assistant may prepare a form-prefill link. The person must check, acknowledge the notices and submit it themselves. Never submit through the old case-video endpoints or grant acknowledgements on their behalf. Exclude sensitive identifiers and documents.
